verdict.rationale: Stripe documents Stablecoin Financial Accounts in which eligible businesses can hold a USDC (or OUSD) balance, explicitly including markets where fiat Treasury isn't available, and can receive, store, send, and spend those funds by card. The feature is honestly labeled Public preview. Missing for 10: a concrete list of supported countries/geographies, stated eligibility criteria behind "eligible businesses", explicit custody terms, and independent or hands-on corroboration of holding a balance.
